bioconda.name: alloshp
bioconda.summary: From mapped reads to Single Homeologous Polymorphisms (SHPs): pipeline for phylogenetic studies of allopolyploids
bioconda.description: This 3-step protocol computes Whole Genome Alignments (WGA) to discover Single Homeologous Polymorphisms (SHPs) out of reads mapped to concatenated genome sequeces. It requires FASTA and VCF input files and produces multiple sequence alignments of subgenomes that make up allopolyploids.
